answer: Anchor each identity to one bank account. To join, it submits an account number, and the network sends two micro-deposits under one dollar; it must report both exact amounts within three days to prove control. One person can open only a few accounts, each needing a government ID and a twenty-five dollar minimum. A farm of one thousand fakes needs one thousand accounts, twenty-five thousand dollars locked, and weeks of paperwork, while the ridge stays steep: no account, no identity. The dune of deposits costs a cloner more than any honest agent pays.
